reset_log.intro: A dated record of every publicly-announced change to subscription quotas, rolling windows, and one-off resets for subscription-based code agents. Every entry links to the official record — vendor announcement, help-center article, changelog, or staff post.
reset_log.calendar_helper: Usage resets and rate-limit changes plotted by announcement date.

reset_log.footer_disclaimer: Reset Log is curated manually from vendor announcements and help-center pages. It does not predict future resets — it only records ones that have already been publicly announced.
